beats.text: Six habits that build discipline nothing can shake.
One. Do the hardest thing first, before your willpower gets spent on everything else.
Two. Shrink the task until starting is almost laughably easy. Two minutes beats zero.
Three. Remove the friction. Make the good choice the easy one, and the bad one a hassle.
Four. Never miss twice. One slip is human; two in a row is the start of a new habit.
Five. Keep promises to yourself, even tiny ones. That's where self-trust is built.
Six. Rely on systems, not moods. Motivation visits; a system shows up every day.
Discipline isn't willpower. It's design — a life arranged so the right thing is the easy thing.
